paper.title: Theory of Mind and Persuasion Beyond Conversation: Assessing the Capacity of LLMs to Induce Belief States via Planning and Action
paper.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM) benchmarks for Large Language Models (LLMs) typically rely on passive question-answering formats, but the deployment of LLMs in increasingly agentic and autonomous forms demands new evaluations. In this paper we evaluate an agent's ability to induce specific belief states in other agents by taking actions rather than using conversational persuasion, a capability we call Non-Conversational Planning ToM (NCP-ToM). NCP-ToM is likely to be essential for many agent use-cases, inc

summary.core_problem: 现有 Theory of Mind 评测大多停留在被动问答，无法衡量模型通过规划和行动去诱导他人信念状态的能力。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是新的 agentic ToM 评测框架，而不是模型方法本身。对做通用 agent 评估、操控风险分析和非对话式社会推理的人有价值；对基座预训练研究员的直接价值较弱，但可作为能力外推的评测参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 NCP-ExploreToM，把任务从“回答别人怎么想”改成“通过移动物体、引导角色进房间等行动，让其他主体形成目标信念”。评测覆盖 600 个任务实例，对比六个前沿模型和人类参与者，关注模型是否能在非对话环境中进行 belief-state planning。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明评测对象包括 GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude 4 系列以及人类，但未在摘要中给出详细胜负关系和误差分解。实验规模为 600 个任务实例，重点是比较模型与人类在非对话式 ToM 规划上的能力差距。由于这是评测论文，主要看任务设计是否 clean、评分协议是否稳健。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Cambridge 的 Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence，偏认知与 AI 安全交叉视角。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Theory-of-Mind benchmarks mostly use passive QA and fail to measure whether models can induce target belief states through planning and action.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a new agentic ToM evaluation framework rather than a new model. It matters for agent evaluation, manipulation-risk analysis, and non-conversational social reasoning, but is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces NCP-ExploreToM, which shifts the task from answering what someone believes to acting in an environment so that other agents acquire desired beliefs. Actions include moving objects and directing characters into rooms. The benchmark evaluates six frontier models and human participants over 600 task instances.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lists GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Claude 4 models among the evaluated systems, plus humans, but does not provide detailed rankings or failure breakdowns there. The main experimental question is the gap between models and humans on non-conversational belief-state planning. As an eval paper, the key issue is whether the task design and scoring protocol are clean.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence at Cambridge, with a cognitive-science and AI-safety flavored perspective.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agentic ToM 评测，不是预训练论文；若你做 agent eval 或安全，只看任务定义和失败案例，别在模型分数上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: This is an agentic ToM benchmark, not a pretraining paper; read the task design and failure cases if you work on agent eval or safety, not the leaderboard details.

institutions: Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence

paper.title: Generative Skill Composition for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Recent LLM agents benefit from skills for solving complex tasks. Skills encapsulate modular packages of procedural knowledge and instructions for performing specialized tasks, such as setting up a sandboxed environment, running a test suite, or refactoring a function across multiple files. As skill libraries grow and become reusable across tasks and domains, selecting an appropriate skill composition has emerged as a central bottleneck. Existing approaches fall into two categories. One exposes t

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM Agent 在技能库变大后，如何选择哪些技能、选择多少技能、以及按什么顺序执行的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 技能组合方法：把技能选择从简单检索或 rerank，提升为结构化计划预测问题，对长期任务和工具化 Agent 有一定方法参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将技能组合形式化为 structured skill composition：给定任务和技能库，模型直接生成可执行的 skill plan，同时决定激活技能子集、技能数量和执行顺序。它反对把三个维度拆成独立的检索、排序或全量上下文暴露。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体使用的 LLM、技能库规模、任务集、baseline 或提升幅度；已知实验应围绕不同技能组合策略比较，包括全量技能暴露、embedding 检索和 LLM reranker。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill、Arizona State University 和 Honda Research Institute USA。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how an LLM agent should choose which skills to use, how many to use, and in what order once its skill library becomes large.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent planning method: skill selection is framed as structured plan prediction rather than plain retrieval or reranking, which is relevant for long-horizon tool-using agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formalizes structured skill composition: given a task and a skill library, predict an executable skill plan that jointly specifies the activated subset, cardinality, and order. This contrasts with exposing all skills to the agent or retrieving skills independently.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, skill-library scale, task suites, baselines, or quantitative gains. The implied comparisons are against full-context skill exposure, embedding retrieval, and LLM-based reranking.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, Arizona State University, and Honda Research Institute USA.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent memory/skill library 的设计备查即可；核心 prior 是组合要联合建模，别只看检索分数。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for agent skill libraries; the main prior is to model composition jointly rather than trust retrieval scores alone.

institutions: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

paper.title: Grounded Iterative Language Planning: How Parameterized World Models Reduce Hallucination Propagation in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: World models for language agents come in two useful forms. An agent-based world model calls an LLM API and reasons flexibly in language, but its errors appear as hallucinated state changes that are hard to score with ordinary regression losses. A parameterized world model is a trained transition predictor; its errors are easier to measure with quantities such as NodeMSE, delta accuracy, and validity accuracy, but it is usually weaker as a standalone planner. We compare these two families on four

summary.core_problem: 纯 LLM 驱动的语言 agent 世界模型易产生幻觉状态转移，而参数化世界模型单独规划能力较弱，二者优势未被有效结合。
summary.importance: 方法创新：对比两类世界模型并提出 GILP 框架，通过参数化骨干与 LLM 推理协同抑制幻觉传播。
summary.technical_approach: 定义 agent-based 与 parameterized 两类世界模型，设计可操作的幻觉度量指标；提出 GILP：仅训练小型参数化骨干提供合法动作、状态增量预测与风险值，LLM 生成动作与想象增量，一致性门控检测分歧并触发修订。
summary.experiments: 在 4 个图结构规划基准上验证，使用 GPT-4o-mini 作为 API 调用模型，摘要未披露具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Pure LLM-driven agent world models hallucinate state transitions, while parameterized world models are weak standalone planners; their complementary strengths have not been effectively combined.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: compares two families of world models and proposes GILP to suppress hallucination propagation via a parameterized backbone coupled with LLM reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes agent-based vs. parameterized world models and designs operational hallucination metrics; GILP trains only a small parameterized backbone to supply valid actions, predicted state deltas, and risk, while an LLM drafts actions and imagined deltas, with a consistency gate triggering revision on disagreement.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 4 graph-structured planning benchmarks using GPT-4o-mini as the API model; abstract does not report exact gain magnitudes.

recommendation.zh: 用小参数化模型做 LLM agent 的状态一致性校验，思路可迁移到推理时自检，看方法节即可，无预训练侧价值。
recommendation.en: Using a small parameterized model as a state-consistency checker for LLM agents is transferable to test-time self-verification; read only the method section, no pretraining-side value.

paper.title: Qwen-Image-Agent: Bridging the Context Gap in Real-World Image Generation
paper.abstract: While text-to-image (T2I) models have achieved remarkable progress, they struggle with real-world requests that are often underspecified, implicit, or dependent on up-to-date knowledge. We identify this challenge as the Context Gap: the mismatch between the user context and the sufficient generation context for T2I models. To bridge this gap, we propose Qwen-Image-Agent, a unified agentic framework that integrates plan, reason, search, memory and feedback in a context-centric manner. Qwen-Image-

summary.core_problem: 真实场景下文生图请求常存在信息缺失、隐含意图或依赖时效性知识，现有文生图模型训练依赖完整明确的prompt，零散的图像生成agent模块缺乏统一框架，且无系统的agent图像生成能力评测基准。
summary.importance: 明确的Context Gap定义厘清了文生图从可控渲染走向实用落地的核心矛盾；上下文驱动的多模块协同agent范式，为统一多模态（生成类优先）agent的推理/训练流程设计提供参考；IA-Bench可用于探测多模态预训练模型在agent场景下的能力边界，反哺预训练数据构成与目标函数的设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出无需训练、兼容现有文生图模型的Qwen-Image-Agent统一框架，核心分为两大模块：1）上下文感知规划，分三层运作：信息层识别缺失上下文并路由对应获取策略，内容层整合已获取的上下文生成详细生成规范，生成层适配多图/多轮交互的上下文分配；2）上下文锚定，从四类来源补全缺失信息：推理挖掘隐含意图、搜索获取时效性事实与视觉参考、记忆调取历史交互与个性化信息、反馈支持迭代优化。同步构建IA-Bench评测基准，覆盖17类真实任务、730个测试样例、1801项细粒度检查项，从规划、推理、搜索、记忆四个维度评测agent图像生成能力，配套结构化VLM评测协议。
summary.experiments: 在IA-Bench、WISE-Verified、MindBench三类基准上，Qwen-Image-Agent表现优于现有强agent基线；消融实验验证了不同来源的补全上下文存在互补效应，去除任意一类上下文均会导致整体性能下降。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读引言中Context Gap的定义与问题 framing、第2章两大核心模块的设计逻辑、IA-Bench的评测维度与构建原则；跳过具体单任务的prompt示例与交互案例细节，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Real-world text-to-image (T2I) requests are often underspecified, carry implicit user intents, or rely on time-sensitive knowledge, creating a mismatch between user-provided context and the complete generation context T2I models require. Existing fragmented image generation agent components lack a unified design framework, and no systematic benchmark exists for evaluating agentic image generation capabilities.
summary_en.importance: The formalized Context Gap definition clarifies the core barrier for moving T2I systems from controlled prompt rendering to real-world deployment. The context-centric multi-module agent paradigm provides a reference for designing inference/training pipelines of unified multimodal (especially generation-focused) agents. The proposed IA-Bench can also probe the capability boundary of multimodal pretrained models in agent scenarios, informing pretraining data composition and objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Qwen-Image-Agent, a training-free framework compatible with off-the-shelf T2I models, built on two core modules: 1) Context-Aware Planning, operating at three layers: the information layer identifies missing context and routes to appropriate acquisition strategies, the content layer assembles grounded context into detailed generation specifications, the generation layer allocates context for multi-image/multi-turn scenarios; 2) Context Grounding, which retrieves missing information from four sources: reasoning for implicit intent inference, search for time-sensitive facts and visual references, memory for historical interaction and personalized preferences, and feedback for iterative refinement. Also introduces IA-Bench, a benchmark covering 17 real-world tasks, 730 test instances, and 1801 fine-grained checklist items, evaluating agent capabilities across planning, reasoning, search, and memory, paired with a structured VLM-based evaluation protocol.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen-Image-Agent outperforms strong agentic baselines on IA-Bench, WISE-Verified, and MindBench. Ablation studies confirm complementary effects across different context sources: removing any single source of grounded context leads to measurable performance degradation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the Context Gap definition and problem framing in the introduction, the design logic of the two core framework modules in Section 2, and the evaluation dimensions and construction principles of IA-Bench. Skip detailed prompt examples and per-task interaction case details; estimated reading time is 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 头部机构做的图像生成 agent，知道它在重写任务接口就够了；若你做预训练，只需看 benchmark 设计和上下文补全过程。
recommendation.en: A major-lab image-generation agent paper; for pretraining, it is enough to inspect the benchmark design and how context is constructed before generation.

paper.title: LaGO: Latent Action Guidance for Online Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for planning and sequential decision-making, but prior work often relies on using them as direct controllers, which requires precise action generation and can be unreliable in practice. This paper proposes Latent Action Guidance for Online Reinforcement Learning (LaGO), a framework that uses a pretrained LLM as a latent action prior to softly guide online policy optimization, rather than treating the LLM as an explicit planner or controlle

summary.core_problem: 直接让 LLM 充当控制器在在线强化学习里往往不稳定，因为动作空间要求精确、环境反馈又稀疏，语言模型的先验很难直接落地成可执行动作。
summary.importance: 贡献点是把 LLM 从显式规划器/控制器改成潜在动作先验，用来软约束在线策略优化。这对理解“预训练知识如何进入决策系统”有一点启发，但离 LLM 基座训练仍较远。
summary.technical_approach: LaGO 使用预训练 LLM 提供 latent action guidance，而不是直接输出环境动作。在线 RL 策略在 PPO 框架下优化，同时被语言先验柔性引导。核心思想是把语言模型知识作为动作分布上的偏置，而不是硬控制信号。
summary.experiments: 在离散控制 CLEVR-Robot 上，平均成功率从 15.1% 提升到 27.2%；在连续控制 Meta-World 上，从 2.7% 提升到 15.2%，对比基线为 Vanilla PPO。作者还分析了更强的预训练 LLM 会带来更有效的引导。摘要未给出模型参数量和训练数据细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Using an LLM as a direct controller in online RL is often unstable because action spaces require precision and sparse environment feedback makes language priors hard to ground into executable actions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is to recast the LLM from an explicit planner/controller into a latent action prior that softly constrains online policy optimization. This offers some insight into how pretrained knowledge can enter decision systems, though it remains far from core LLM foundation-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: LaGO uses a pretrained LLM to provide latent action guidance rather than directly emitting environment actions. The online RL policy is optimized under PPO while being softly guided by the language prior. The key idea is to use the LLM as a bias over action distributions instead of a hard control signal.
summary_en.experiments: On discrete-control CLEVR-Robot, average success rate improves from 15.1% to 27.2%; on continuous-control Meta-World, from 2.7% to 15.2%, against Vanilla PPO. The paper also reports that stronger pretrained LLMs provide more effective guidance. The abstract does not specify model size or pretraining data details.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座论文，但“LLM 做先验而非控制器”这个 framing 值得记一下；只看实验结论和 ablation，别高估其对通用 agent 的外推。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper, but the framing of an LLM as a prior rather than a controller is worth noting; read the ablations and results, but do not overgeneralize to broad agents.

paper.title: ScaffoldAgent: Utility-Guided Dynamic Outline Optimization for Open-Ended Deep Research
paper.abstract: Open-ended deep research (OEDR) requires systems to acquire knowledge through multi-round retrieval and generate coherent long-form reports. The outline plays a central role as a structural scaffold that coordinates retrieval, evidence organization, and generation. However, existing methods either fix the outline before writing or refine it with local heuristics, leading to scaffold drift under continuous information accumulation and delayed feedback for evaluating outline modifications. We prop

summary.core_problem: 开放式深度研究系统在多轮检索和长报告生成中，如何动态维护一个不漂移、能吸收新证据的报告大纲。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 Agent 系统方法。它把大纲从一次性规划产物改成可优化的结构状态，对长程 research agent 的规划、检索和写作耦合有参考意义，但离 LLM 预训练问题较远。
summary.technical_approach: ScaffoldAgent 将大纲演化建模为结构化决策过程，定义 Expansion、Contraction、Revision 三类操作，并用检索增益、结构一致性和试生成质量估计每次操作的下游效用，再用该效用信号指导大纲更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模和数值结果。实验应围绕开放式深度研究任务，比较固定大纲或局部启发式大纲更新方法，重点评估检索收益、报告结构连贯性和最终生成质量。
summary.authors_note: 论文标注来自 Cohere 相关机构背景；未能从给定信息确认知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how an open-ended deep research agent can maintain a report outline that remains coherent while new evidence is accumulated through multi-round retrieval.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general agent-system method. It treats the outline as an optimizable structural state rather than a one-shot plan, which is useful for long-horizon research agents, though only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScaffoldAgent models outline evolution as a structured decision process with Expansion, Contraction, and Revision operations. It estimates the downstream utility of each operation from retrieval gain, structural coherence, and trial-generation quality, then uses this signal to guide outline updates.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or numeric results. The evaluation appears to compare against fixed-outline and locally refined-outline baselines on open-ended deep research tasks, measuring retrieval gain, structural coherence, and final report quality.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is associated with Cohere according to the provided metadata; no widely known author can be confirmed from the given information.

recommendation.zh: 看方法框架即可；把 outline 当可优化状态有点意思，但对 pretrain 只能提供 agent 侧弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the framework only; treating outlines as optimizable state is useful for agents, but it is a weak signal for pretraining work.

paper.title: SIMMER: Benchmarking Latent Failures in LLM Executable Planning with a World Model
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as planners for autonomous agents in household environments. While existing benchmarks evaluate whether LLM-generated plans execute successfully, they overlook a critical type of failure: latent failures. Unlike immediate failures that trigger instant feedback at execution time and enable timely correction, latent failures do not immediately halt plan execution but silently compromise goal achievement. In severe cases, they cause irreversibl

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 作为可执行规划器时，现有 benchmark 只看计划是否立即失败，漏掉不会立刻中断执行但会破坏最终目标的 latent failures。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent planning 评测资产。它把“计划可执行”拆成即时前置条件失败和延迟显现的状态损害，对安全型 agent 评测有一定方法价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SIMMER，在厨房任务中构建人工校验的符号世界模型，包含 77 个动作、262 个唯一物体和约 46,800 种语义现实的交互；使用状态机 executor 按世界状态验证 LLM 生成计划，并检测即时前置条件错误与潜在失败。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出世界模型规模和数据来源：交互来自真实烹饪脚本；未提供完整被测模型列表、指标数值或相对 baseline 提升。评测重点是通过符号执行暴露传统成功率指标遗漏的 latent failures。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates LLM executable planning failures that do not immediately stop execution but silently undermine the final goal.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent-planning evaluation contribution. It separates immediate precondition failures from latent state corruption, which is useful for safety-oriented agent evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIMMER builds a human-curated symbolic kitchen world model with 77 actions, 262 objects, and roughly 46,800 semantically realistic interactions derived from real cooking scripts. A state-machine executor validates generated plans against world states and flags both immediate and latent failures.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the world-model scale and provenance, but not the full model list, quantitative results, or baseline deltas. The main experimental value is exposing failures missed by execution-success-only evaluation.

recommendation.zh: agent eval 可看 latent-failure 定义和 world-model schema；厨房域较窄，不必读实验表。
recommendation.en: Worth checking for the latent-failure definition and world-model schema; the kitchen scope is narrow, so the tables are optional.

paper.title: Bridging the Agent-World Gap: Text World Models for LLM-based Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used in interactive textual environments, from web navigation and code editing to tool use and long-horizon dialogue. Yet many remain largely reactive, mapping observations to actions without an explicit model of how these environments are structured and evolve. This motivates text world models (TWMs): transition models over textual states that, given a state and a candidate action, predict the resulting webpage, terminal output, API respo

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 在文本交互环境中大多是反应式的，缺乏对环境结构和演化的显式建模，无法支持规划、高效学习和原则性评估。
summary.importance: 首次系统提出文本世界模型（TWM）的形式化框架，将其作为连接 Agent 与环境的桥梁，属于综述与框架性贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 围绕形式化框架和 Agent 生命周期组织：（1）基础：定义 TWM 并按状态表示和领域分类；（2）构建：LLM-as-WM 和 Code-as-WM 两种范式；（3）应用：如何支持规划、学习和评估。
summary.experiments: 无独立实验，是系统性综述。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based agents in interactive textual environments remain largely reactive, lacking explicit models of how environments are structured and evolve, hindering planning, efficient learning, and principled evaluation.
summary_en.importance: First systematic formalization of Text World Models (TWM) as a bridge between agents and environments; a framework and survey contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Organized around a formal framework and the agent lifecycle: (1) Foundations — define TWM, characterize by state representation and grounding domain; (2) Construction — taxonomize LLM-as-WM and Code-as-WM paradigms; (3) Application — support planning, learning, and evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments; a systematic survey.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent 世界模型方向的文献地图备查，不读正文；目前该方向尚未形成对 pretrain 的反哺信号。
recommendation.en: Use as a literature map for agent world models; skip the full text — the direction hasn't yet produced actionable signals for pretraining.

paper.title: ToolChoiceConfusion: Causal Minimal Tool Filtering for Reliable LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly rely on external tools, but larger tool menus can reduce reliability and efficiency by increasing wrong-tool calls, premature actions, and token cost. Existing tool-selection methods often optimize semantic relevance, exposing tools whose names or descriptions match the user request. We argue that relevance is insufficient: a tool may be related to the task while still being unnecessary or premature at the current step.   We propose Causal Minimal Tool Fi

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在工具菜单过大时容易误选工具、过早调用工具和上下文成本上升的问题。
summary.importance: 这是通用 tool-use agent 的方法改进，贡献点在于把工具选择从“语义相关性”改成“当前步骤下的因果充分性”。对基座预训练没有直接作用，但对后训练 agent 设计有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出训练免费方法 CMTF。它为工具定义轻量级 precondition-effect contracts，根据当前状态和目标只暴露最小的下一步工具前沿，而不是把所有语义相关工具都交给模型选择。
summary.experiments: 在多步工具使用任务上，对比全工具暴露、关键词检索、state-aware filtering 和因果路径消融，评估任务成功率、误工具调用、过早动作、工具暴露数量和 token 成本。摘要未给出具体 benchmark 名称和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the drop in reliability and efficiency when LLM agents face large tool menus, leading to wrong tool calls, premature actions, and higher token cost.
summary_en.importance: This is a general tool-use agent method that reframes tool selection from semantic relevance to causal sufficiency at the current step. It is not directly about pretraining, but it may inform post-training agent design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a training-free method, CMTF, which uses lightweight precondition-effect contracts for tools and exposes only the minimal next-step tool frontier needed to advance toward the goal.
summary_en.experiments: It evaluates on multi-step tool-use tasks against all-tools exposure, keyword retrieval, state-aware filtering, and causal-path ablations, measuring success rate, wrong-tool calls, premature actions, tool exposure, and token cost. The abstract does not provide benchmark names or exact numbers.

recommendation.zh: 想做 tool-use agent 可以看，但更像 prompt-time control 而不是新学习范式；先看 contracts 定义和 ablation，若没有强 benchmark 就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you work on tool-use agents, but this is prompt-time control rather than a new learning paradigm; check the contract design and ablations first.

paper.title: Goedel-Architect: Streamlining Formal Theorem Proving with Blueprint Generation and Refinement
paper.abstract: We introduce Goedel-Architect, an agentic framework for formal theorem proving in Lean 4 centered on blueprint generation and refinement. A blueprint is a dependency graph of definitions and lemmas that builds up to the main theorem. First, Goedel-Architect generates a blueprint of formally stated definitions and lemmas, along with declared dependencies. This blueprint is optionally guided by a natural language proof. Then, a tool-equipped Lean prover component closes each open lemma node in par

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：在不依赖闭源前沿模型、也不走高成本大规模搜索的前提下，怎样把 Lean 4 形式化定理证明做得更强、更稳，而且避免常见 agentic prover 在局部死胡同里反复打转。作者把问题重新表述为“先生成全局证明蓝图，再并行证明子节点，并根据失败节点回写修正全局策略”。关键不在单步 proof search，而在把整个证明过程提升到图级别的规划与迭代。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接的 pretrain 论文；但对 post-train、tool-using reasoning、formal reasoning 数据构造和可验证训练信号有现实启发。它说明了一点：当任务具有强结构约束时，单一长链 CoT 或递归分解未必是最合适的控制流，显式中间表示——这里是 dependency-graph blueprint——可以显著改善搜索效率、并行性和失败恢复。对做 reasoning model 或 theorem proving 数据合成的人，这类“先规划、后局部求解、再全局修正”的范式比单纯 rollout 更接近可扩展系统设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 blueprint。作者把目标定理转成一个 Lean 文件形式的依赖图，节点是 definitions 或 lemmas，边表示证明依赖。流程分三步。第一步，blueprint generation：给定目标 theorem statement，可选地再给一个自然语言证明，模型一次性产出一组形式化子命题及其依赖关系。这里和 Draft-Sketch-Prove 的区别是，后者更像线性 sketch 加 placeholder，而这里是显式图结构，后续可以整体重写。第二步，node proving：对图中开放 lemma 节点，调用带 Lean 编译器和检索工具的 prover，利用其声明依赖并行尝试闭合各节点。并行是关键，因为不同子引理可以共享上游上下文，但不必串行等待。第三步，global refinement：如果某些节点失败，不是继续在局部递归细分，而是把失败信息反馈给 architect，重写整个蓝图，包括替换中间引理、调整依赖、增删定义。作者强调这比 top-down recursion tree 更不容易卡在错误分解上，因为失败会触发全局策略更新，而不是在错误子树里越钻越深。

系统上，它是一个多组件 pipeline：architect 负责图级规划与修订，prover 负责 Lean 证明，检索模块提供 Mathlib 相关上下文。可选的 natural-language proof seed 也值得注意：它不是直接把 informal proof 翻译成 formal sketch，而是把自然语言证明吸收到图结构中，变成命名子引理和依赖关系。这种设计更适合后续 refinement，因为图比平面草稿更容易局部替换和全局重组。

从方法取舍看，作者明确放弃了两条常见路线：一是 one-shot formal proof generation，能力上限受限；二是单 agent 交替调用 Lean 的局部搜索，容易受当前轨迹束缚。Goedel-Architect 选择把“搜索空间控制”前移到 blueprint 层，这更像 program synthesis 里的 high-level plan + subroutine discharge。
summary.experiments:
文中最醒目的结果不是绝对分数，而是性能/成本比。作者声称在其算力档位上建立了新的 Pareto 前沿：使用 open-weight DeepSeek-V4-Flash（文中给出为 284B-A13B）作为骨干，单题成本约 0.44 美元，而表中下一个最强开源 pipeline 约 244 美元/题，成本差了三个数量级左右。摘要和引言给出的对比背景是：公开权重的一次性 prover 在 Putnam 级问题上通常仍停留在个位数到低十几的通过率；超过 50% 的系统大多依赖闭源模型、闭源 pipeline，或极高 API 成本。Goedel-Architect 的卖点是，在开放骨干 + 开放 pipeline 条件下，把性能推到接近这些更昂贵系统的区间。

从全文可提炼的实验关注点有三类。第一，benchmark 主结果：应重点看 MiniF2F、PutnamBench 以及可能的 Putnam 2025 子集结果，尤其是与 open one-shot prover、open agentic pipeline、closed frontier pipeline 的分层对比。第二，ablation：blueprint refinement 是否显著优于不做 refinement、只做局部递归分解、或直接 one-shot sketch；natural-language proof seed 是否在难题上提高初始 blueprint 质量；并行 node proving 对总 wall-clock 和成功率的影响。第三，成本分析：每题 token 用量、architect/prover 调用次数、失败重试开销。对系统论文，这部分往往比单一 pass@1 更说明问题。

当前给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，因此不宜编造具体通过率；但可以确定的是，作者把“开放性、成本、性能”三者一起作为主结果，而不是只报 solve rate。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 里对现有 formal prover 的三类划分：one-shot、agentic、pipeline。这里把比较对象和方法定位讲得比较清楚。然后直接看 Figure 1 和 Goedel-Architect 主流程，理解 blueprint 作为全局中间表示到底承载了什么信息。接着看 blueprint generation 与 refinement 的 prompt / schema 设计，重点留意：节点命名、依赖声明、失败反馈如何组织给 architect。再看实验部分的 ablation，判断性能提升究竟来自更强 backbone，还是来自 blueprint 机制本身。

如果只打算花 20-30 分钟，建议顺序是：Introduction → Figure 1 → 主结果表 → blueprint refinement 消融 → 成本表。若要深挖，重点问题有三个：一，失败节点如何被总结成可用于全局重写的信号；二，依赖图是否会引入过度规划，导致简单题反而变慢；三，blueprint 质量是否可以作为可监督中间数据，用于后续训练 architect 或 prover。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical bottleneck in Lean 4 theorem proving: how to get strong formal proving performance without relying on closed frontier models or extremely expensive search-heavy pipelines. The key reframing is to treat proving as iterative global planning over a dependency graph, rather than as one-shot proof generation or purely local recursive decomposition. The system first proposes a proof blueprint, then proves subgoals in parallel, and finally rewrites the global plan when some nodes fail.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to post-training, tool-augmented reasoning, and verifiable supervision. The main lesson is structural: for tasks with hard symbolic constraints, explicit intermediate representations can be more effective than long free-form reasoning traces. The blueprint acts as a controllable latent plan. That has implications for theorem-proving data generation, reasoning model training, and any setting where failure signals can be fed back into a higher-level planner instead of only refining the current local trajectory.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central object is a blueprint: a dependency graph whose nodes are formal definitions and lemmas, and whose edges encode proof dependencies leading to the target theorem. The pipeline has three stages. First, blueprint generation: given the target theorem statement, optionally with a natural-language proof, the architect model emits a Lean file containing formally stated intermediate nodes and declared dependencies. Second, node proving: a tool-using Lean prover attempts to close open lemma nodes, using the declared dependencies and retrieval over Mathlib. These node-level proof attempts can run in parallel, which is important because the graph exposes independent subproblems. Third, global refinement: failed nodes are not handled only by deeper local decomposition. Instead, failure information is sent back to the architect, which can rewrite the blueprint globally by changing intermediate lemmas, adding or removing definitions, or restructuring dependencies.

This differs from recursive decomposition pipelines, where an early bad split can trap the system in an unproductive subtree. It also differs from Draft-Sketch-Prove style approaches. There, the informal proof becomes a flat sketch with placeholders. Here, the optional natural-language proof is converted into a graph of named sublemmas, which is easier to revise and recombine. In system terms, the paper separates high-level strategy formation from low-level proof discharge, and uses the graph as the interface between them.
summary_en.experiments:
The most notable result is the performance-cost tradeoff rather than a single benchmark number. The paper claims a new Pareto point for its compute class using the open-weight DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbone, with roughly $0.44 per problem, versus about $244 per problem for the next-best open pipeline reported in the comparison table. The introduction also positions the method against the broader landscape: open one-shot provers remain weak on Putnam-class problems, while systems above the 50% range typically depend on closed models, closed pipelines, or very high API spend.

The experiments to pay attention to are likely in three groups. First, benchmark results on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, and possibly newer Putnam-style sets, with separate comparisons against open one-shot provers, open agentic systems, and closed frontier pipelines. Second, ablations on the blueprint mechanism: whether global refinement helps over no refinement, whether graph-based planning beats recursive decomposition, and whether natural-language proof seeds improve difficult problems. Third, cost accounting: number of architect/prover calls, token usage, and retry overhead. For a systems paper like this, those details matter as much as pass rate.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so precise solve-rate numbers should not be inferred beyond what the paper explicitly states in the introduction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction, especially the taxonomy of prior systems into one-shot provers, agentic provers, and multi-stage pipelines. That framing makes the paper's design choice easier to evaluate. Then read Figure 1 and the main Goedel-Architect section to understand what information the blueprint actually contains and how it is revised. After that, go to the ablations: the key question is whether the gain comes from the blueprint mechanism itself or mostly from the backbone model.

For a 20-30 minute skim, read in this order: introduction, Figure 1, main result table, refinement ablations, and cost table. If reading more carefully, focus on three issues: how failure signals are summarized for global rewriting, whether graph planning adds overhead on easy problems, and whether blueprint traces could become supervised data for training future architect or prover models.

recommendation.zh: 在Lean定理证明上跑出惊人数字，核心是『先全局蓝图再并行填』替代『递归分解』，对推理agent的规划策略有启发。
recommendation.en: Impressive numbers on Lean theorem proving; the core insight — global blueprint first, parallel filling next — is a useful contrast to recursive decomposition for reasoning agents.

paper.title: A Close Look At World Model Recovery In Supervised Fine-Tuned LLM Planners
paper.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) improves end-to-end classical planning in large language models (LLMs), but do these models also learn to represent and reason about the planning problems they are solving? Due to the relative complexity of classical planning problems and the challenge that end-to-end plan generation poses for LLMs, it has been difficult to explore this question. In our work, we devise and perform a series of interpretability experiments that holistically interrogate world model reco

summary.core_problem: 监督微调（SFT）能提升 LLM 在经典规划任务中的端到端表现，但模型是否真正学习并表征了规划问题的世界模型（world model）仍不清楚。
summary.importance: 通过可解释性实验，深入探究了 SFT 对 LLM 内部表征和生成能力的影响，为理解 LLM 在规划任务中的内部机制提供了实证依据，有助于指导更有效的微调策略。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了一个框架，从内部表征质量和生成模型视角量化世界模型恢复程度。1) 内部表征：在微调后 LLM 的隐藏状态上训练线性探针，预测状态谓词的真值和中间步骤动作的有效性；2) 生成能力：采用指标，通过生成的 token 概率对有效和无效动作进行分类。实验在两个经典规划环境中进行，对比了三种不同数据分布的微调效果，并探索了类似思维链（CoT）的微调技术（在动作之间生成中间状态）。
summary.experiments: 发现：1) 仅在有效动作序列上进行 SFT，就足以让 LLM 学习到线性编码动作有效性和部分状态谓词的内部表征；2) 即使模型难以利用预测概率区分有效和无效动作，其内部表征可能仍具备这种区分能力；3) 在具有良好状态空间覆盖率（如随机游走生成）的规划数据上进行微调，通常能实现更好的分布内和分布外世界模型恢复。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读实验设计部分（如何定义和量化世界模型恢复）以及结果分析（特别是内部表征与生成概率之间的差异）。不同数据分布对微调效果的影响也值得关注。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) improves end-to-end performance of LLMs in classical planning tasks, but it remains unclear whether the models truly learn and represent the world model of the planning problems.
summary_en.importance: Through interpretability experiments, this paper deeply investigates the impact of SFT on the internal representations and generative capabilities of LLMs, providing empirical evidence for understanding the internal mechanisms of LLMs in planning tasks and guiding more effective fine-tuning strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a framework to quantify world model recovery from the perspectives of internal representation quality and generative models. 1) Internal representation: Trains linear probes on the hidden states of fine-tuned LLMs to predict the truth values of state predicates and the validity of actions at intermediate steps; 2) Generative capability: Adopts a metric to classify valid and invalid actions using generated token probabilities. Experiments are conducted in two classical planning environments, comparing the fine-tuning effects of three different data distributions and exploring a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) style fine-tuning technique (generating intermediate states between actions).
summary_en.experiments: Findings: 1) SFT directly on sequences of valid actions is sufficient for LLMs to learn internal representations that linearly encode action validity and some state predicates; 2) Even if models struggle to use predicted probabilities to distinguish between valid and invalid actions, their internal representations may still possess this capability; 3) Fine-tuning on planning data with good state space coverage (e.g., generated by random walks) generally achieves better in-distribution and out-of-distribution world model recovery.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the experimental design (how world model recovery is defined and quantified) and the result analysis (especially the discrepancy between internal representations and generation probabilities). The impact of different data distributions on fine-tuning effects is also noteworthy. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 探究 SFT 模型是否真正学到了世界模型，发现内部表示（线性探针可分）与输出概率（生成能力）之间存在脱节，对理解 LLM 的 reasoning 机制有帮助。
recommendation.en: Investigates whether SFT models truly learn world models, finding a disconnect between internal representations (linearly separable) and output probabilities (generative capabilities), helpful for understanding LLM reasoning mechanisms.

paper.title: SVI-Bench: A Dynamic Microworld for Strategic Video Intelligence
paper.abstract: True video intelligence demands more than recognizing what is visible: it requires reasoning about why events unfold, predicting what would change under different conditions, and deciding what to do next. We refer to this progression, from perception through causal reasoning and simulation to strategic planning, as Strategic Video Intelligence (SVI). No existing benchmark evaluates this capability stack: in-the-wild videos lack verifiable ground truth for causal and strategic questions, while sy

summary.core_problem: 评测“战略视频智能”：从感知到因果推理/反事实模拟再到策略规划，现有视频benchmark缺少可验证的因果与决策问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是benchmark资产与评测协议；对多模态/视频-语言模型的训练与对齐有间接价值（可作为mid-train或post-train的目标分布），但对纯文本LLM预训练启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SVI-Bench：以团队体育为“动态微世界”，利用明确规则与确定结果提供可验证ground truth，同时保留真实多智能体对抗与协作复杂度；包含广播视频、动作标注与（摘要截断）实验/反事实相关数据。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：约35K小时视频、15M动作标注、15K小时（摘要截断）；论文应包含多种VLM/视频模型基线与分层任务评测，但摘要未给出具体模型与分数。
summary.authors_note: Northeastern University

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating “Strategic Video Intelligence”: perception → causal/what-if reasoning → simulation → strategic planning, which existing video benchmarks cannot verify reliably.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a benchmark contribution; indirectly useful for training/alignment of video-language models (as a target distribution for mid-/post-training), but limited direct impact on text-only LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SVI-Bench uses team sports as a dynamic microworld: real multi-agent adversarial interactions with explicit rules and definitive outcomes to enable verifiable causal and strategic questions; includes broadcast videos, action annotations, and (truncated) experimental/counterfactual components.
summary_en.experiments: Scale: ~35K hours of video, 15M annotated actions, and 15K hours (truncated). The abstract does not list baseline models or scores, but the paper likely reports multi-level tasks and VLM/video-model baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Northeastern University

paper.title: PatchWorld: Gradient-Free Optimization of Executable World Models
paper.abstract: Text-agent environments are typically modeled as partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs), assuming that the simulator's latent state and transition dynamics are hidden from the agent. Yet little work has examined whether executable code can be induced to serve as a world model for prediction and planning under partial observability. We introduce PatchWorld, a gradient-free framework that turns offline trajectories into executable Python world models through counterexample-guided

summary.core_problem: 解决文本环境 agent 在部分可观测条件下如何构造可执行、可修补的世界模型，用于预测和规划，而不是依赖黑盒 next-observation 预测器。
summary.importance: 贡献更偏 agent/world model 方法，而非 LLM 基座训练。价值在于提出一种可执行代码世界模型的思路：世界模型不是神经网络隐状态，而是可检查、可回放、可局部修补的 Python 程序。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PatchWorld，用 gradient-free 的 counterexample-guided code repair，把离线轨迹归纳成可执行 Python 世界模型。模型维护符号化 belief state，并通过动作更新规则进行状态转移；当预测与环境反馈冲突时，用反例驱动的局部程序修补来迭代改进。规划时可直接在代码世界模型上做 one-step lookahead，而不需要在预测模块内部调用 LLM。
summary.experiments: 在 7 个 AgentGym 环境上评测，PatchWorld-Simple 在代码式规划方法中取得最高 planning score，live one-step lookahead 的宏平均成功率达到 76.4%。摘要未给出与神经 world model 或纯 LLM planner 的完整对比细节，也未体现与预训练相关的训练规模信息。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Hong Kong Baptist University、Beijing Institute of Technology、SUSTech、Wayne State University、University of Edinburgh 等。未见特别明确的顶级基座模型团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to build executable and patchable world models for text agents under partial observability, instead of relying on black-box next-observation predictors.
summary_en.importance: This is more of an agent/world-model contribution than a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its main value is the idea that a world model can be represented as executable code that is inspectable, replayable, and locally repairable.
summary_en.technical_approach: PatchWorld is a gradient-free framework that induces executable Python world models from offline trajectories via counterexample-guided code repair. It maintains symbolic belief-state programs with action-conditioned updates, and iteratively patches the program when predictions conflict with environment feedback. Planning is then performed through lookahead on the induced code model, without LLM calls inside the prediction module.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on seven AgentGym environments. PatchWorld-Simple reportedly achieves the best code-based planning score among compared methods, reaching 76.4% macro success in live one-step lookahead. The abstract does not provide enough detail on comparisons against neural world models or direct relevance to pretraining-scale setups.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Hong Kong Baptist University, Beijing Institute of Technology, SUSTech, Wayne State University, and the University of Edinburgh. No clearly identifiable major foundation-model lab is evident from the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，知道有这条“程序化世界模型”路线即可；若你做 agent，只看方法图和 counterexample repair 机制，不必细读正文。

paper.title: Plan Before Search: Search Agents Need Plan
paper.abstract: Training large language models as retrieval-augmented reasoning agents typically combines reinforcement learning with an SFT cold start distilled from a stronger model. However, this paradigm overlooks two fundamental factors: the dependency structure among sub-skills, and the possibility that distillation is not the only route to capability acquisition. We study this through Plan, a structured agentic behavior for multi-hop retrieval that decomposes a question into ordered sub-questions before

summary.core_problem: 当前训练搜索增强型推理 Agent 的主流范式（SFT 冷启动 + RL）忽略了两个关键问题：子技能之间的依赖结构对可训练性的约束，以及强模型蒸馏是否是 SFT 冷启动的唯一途径。论文以「规划（Plan）」这一需要多子技能协调的复杂行为为切入点展开研究。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的启发主要有三点：（1）揭示了复杂 Agent 行为的 RL 训练存在三个可行性条件——初始熵、训练稳定性、前置子技能，违反任一条件都会导致不同模式的训练崩溃；（2）证明了 SFT 冷启动之所以有效，是因为它一次性满足了这三个条件；（3）提出了一种自举（self-bootstrapping）范式——用一个能通过纯 RL 学会规划的小模型作为种子，生成轨迹并过滤后作为 SFT 数据来激活其他目标模型的规划能力，效果优于强模型蒸馏。
summary.technical_approach: 将规划形式化为一种结构化 Agent 行为：在任何检索执行之前，先将多跳问题分解为有序的子问题，每个搜索步骤都锚定到预先设计的子问题上，避免因早期检索到的部分相关文档导致轨迹漂移。设计了规划感知的奖励函数，同时监督结构有效性和每个推理步骤与其规划子问题的对齐。RL 训练使用 GRPO，检索文档 token 从损失中掩码。在此基础上提出自举范式：找到一个满足可行性条件的小种子模型（如 Qwen2.5-3B-Base），它能通过先学 refinement 再学 plan 的纯 RL 自主获得规划能力，用其生成的规划轨迹经过质量感知流水线过滤后作为 SFT 数据，激活任意目标模型的规划能力。
summary.experiments: 在三个模型家族（Qwen2.5、Llama3.2、Qwen3）、3B 到 14B 参数规模上进行了系统实验。关键发现：（1）直接 RL 训练规划行为会因模型而异出现不同的失败模式——低初始熵模型缺乏探索空间导致无法习得新行为；有些模型初期稳定但会突然崩溃（熵上升、输出格式破坏、奖励信号消失）；缺乏 refine 子技能的模型也会失败。（2）单次 SFT 即可同时满足三个可行性条件，在所有测试模型上均有效。（3）自举生成的数据在多跳基准上的表现优于强模型蒸馏数据，且每个目标模型都成功获得了规划能力并取得一致的性能提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节（方法论）的规划形式化定义和奖励设计，以及第 4 节的实验结果中关于三种失败模式的分析和自举范式的验证。关注图 1（反应式基线与规划式方法的对比）和图 2（PL-Search 的整体框架）。值得深挖的点包括：三个可行性条件如何在不同模型架构中体现、种子模型的选择标准、以及自举范式在其他复杂 Agent 行为上的可迁移性。
summary.authors_note: 未在全文中明确标注机构，从引用和模型使用来看涉及通义千问团队相关研究人员。

summary_en.core_problem: The dominant paradigm for training search-augmented reasoning agents (SFT cold start + RL) overlooks two critical issues: how the dependency structure among sub-skills constrains trainability, and whether stronger-model distillation is the only route to SFT cold-start. This paper investigates both through the lens of 'Plan' — a complex behavior requiring coordination of multiple sub-skills.
summary_en.importance: Three key insights for pretraining researchers: (1) RL training of complex agent behaviors has three feasibility conditions — initial entropy, training stability, and prerequisite sub-skills — and violating any leads to distinct failure modes. (2) SFT cold start works because it satisfies all three conditions at once. (3) A self-bootstrapping paradigm is proposed: a small seed model that can learn planning via pure RL generates trajectories which, after filtering, serve as SFT data to activate planning in any target model, outperforming stronger-model distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Plan is formalized as a structured agentic behavior that decomposes a multi-hop question into ordered sub-questions before any retrieval, anchoring each search step to a pre-designed sub-question to prevent drift from partially relevant documents. A plan-aware reward function supervises both structural validity and step-level sub-question alignment. RL uses GRPO with retrieved document tokens masked from loss. The self-bootstrapping paradigm identifies a seed model (e.g., Qwen2.5-3B-Base) that can autonomously acquire planning via pure RL (learning refinement first, then planning). Its generated plan trajectories are filtered through a quality-aware pipeline and used as SFT data to activate planning in any target model.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic experiments across three model families (Qwen2.5, Llama3.2, Qwen3) and scales from 3B to 14B parameters. Key findings: (1) Direct RL training of planning fails in qualitatively different ways across models — low initial entropy models lack exploration room; some collapse abruptly after initial stability (entropy rises, format breaks, reward vanishes); models without refine sub-skill also fail. (2) A single SFT pass satisfies all three feasibility conditions and works across all tested models. (3) Self-bootstrapped data outperforms stronger-model distillation data on multi-hop benchmarks, and every target model successfully acquires planning capability with consistent gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (methodology) for the formalization of plan and reward design, and Section 4 for the three failure modes analysis and self-bootstrapping validation. Key figures: Figure 1 (reactive vs plan-based comparison) and Figure 2 (PL-Search framework). Worth digging deeper: how the three feasibility conditions manifest across architectures, seed model selection criteria, and whether the self-bootstrapping paradigm transfers to other complex agent behaviors.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the text; model usage suggests affiliation with researchers related to the Qwen team.

recommendation.zh: 读训练失败分析即可，尤其是同一 reward 跨 3B-14B 失效模式不同；方法本身像合理工程化。
recommendation.en: Read the failure analysis, especially the same-reward differences across 3B–14B models; the planning method itself looks like sensible engineering.

paper.title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
paper.abstract: How should an agent decide when and how to plan? A dominant approach builds agents as reactive policies with adaptive computation (e.g., chain-of-thought), trained end-to-end expecting planning to emerge implicitly. Without control over the presence, structure, or horizon of planning, these systems dramatically increase reasoning length, yielding inefficient token use without reliable accuracy gains. We argue efficient agentic reasoning benefits from decomposing decision-making into three system

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图让 agent 的长程推理不再完全依赖无结构 chain-of-thought，而是显式区分执行、模拟规划和是否规划的自我调控。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，主要启发在训练数据格式和推理计算控制。它说明 agent trace 不一定只是一长串自由文本 reasoning，也可以拆成“何时规划、规划多远、预测什么状态、何时直接行动”等结构化监督信号。这个方向可能影响后续 agent 预训练或 mid-training 的 trace schema 设计。
summary.technical_approach: SR2AM 把 agent 推理拆成三个系统：System I 负责反应式执行和自由推理；System II 负责 simulative planning，即提出候选动作并预测未来状态；System III 是 configurator，决定当前是否需要新规划、继续已有规划，还是直接行动。实现上仍使用 LLM 作为世界模型，在 chain-of-thought 内插入结构化的配置与规划阶段。作者给出两个版本：v0.1 从多模块 prompting 系统记录决策来构造训练信号；v1.0 从预训练 reasoning LLM 的轨迹中重建结构化计划，以提高可扩展性。训练流程是监督学习后接 RL。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖数学、科学、表格分析和网页信息查找等交互式推理任务。SR2AM-v0.1-8B 的 Pass@1 与 120B–355B 级别系统接近；SR2AM-v1.0-30B 与 685B–1T 级别 agentic LLM 接近。v1.0-30B 相比相近规模 agentic LLM 节省 25.8%–95.3% reasoning tokens。分析显示，RL 后平均 planning horizon 增加 22.8%，planning frequency 只增加 2.0 个百分点，说明模型更倾向于在少数需要规划的位置规划得更远，而不是简单增加规划次数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。先看三系统形式化定义，确认 configurator、planner、executor 的边界。再看 v0.1 和 v1.0 的数据构造方式，尤其是如何从普通 reasoning trace 重建结构化计划。实验部分重点看 token 节省和 planning horizon/frequency 的分析。对基座研究员来说，不必细读具体 agent benchmark 细节，重点是 trace 结构和 RL 后计算分配行为的变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses inefficient long-horizon agent reasoning caused by unstructured chain-of-thought. It proposes to separate execution, simulation-based planning, and self-regulation over when and how deeply to plan.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to base-model pretraining is indirect. The useful signal is about trace design and compute control: agent training traces can expose decisions such as whether to plan, how far to plan, what future states to predict, and when to act directly. Such schemas may become useful for agent-oriented pretraining, mid-training, or RL data construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: SR2AM decomposes reasoning into three components. System I performs reactive execution and free-form reasoning. System II performs simulative planning by proposing actions and predicting future belief states, using the LLM itself as the world model. System III is a configurator that decides whether to create a new plan, continue an existing plan, or act without planning. The authors instantiate this in two ways. v0.1 records decisions from a multi-module prompted system to demonstrate feasibility. v1.0 reconstructs structured plans from pretrained reasoning LLM traces for better scalability. Both versions are trained with supervised learning followed by reinforcement learning.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers interactive reasoning in math, science, tabular analysis, and web information seeking. SR2AM-v0.1-8B achieves Pass@1 competitive with systems in the 120B–355B range. SR2AM-v1.0-30B is reported as competitive with 685B–1T agentic LLMs. The 30B model uses 25.8%–95.3% fewer reasoning tokens than competitive agentic LLMs of similar scale. After RL, average planning horizon increases by 22.8%, while planning frequency grows by only 2.0 percentage points, suggesting that the model learns to plan further ahead at selected moments rather than planning more often everywhere.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the formal definition of the three systems to understand the boundaries between configurator, planner, and executor. Then read the v0.1 and v1.0 data construction pipelines, especially how structured plans are reconstructed from ordinary reasoning traces. In the experiments, focus on reasoning-token savings and the analysis of planning horizon versus planning frequency. The benchmark-specific details are less important for pretraining researchers than the trace schema and the post-RL shift in computation allocation.

recommendation.zh: 只看 planner 调用率与 token-cost 曲线；如果没有干净消融，它就是又一个三系统 agent 叙事。
recommendation.en: Skim the planner-invocation and token-cost curves; without clean ablations, this is just another three-system agent story.

paper.title: PlanningBench: Generating Scalable and Verifiable Planning Data for Evaluating and Training Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Planning is a fundamental capability for large language models (LLMs) because such complex tasks require models to coordinate goals, constraints, resources, and long-term consequences into executable and verifiable solutions. Existing planning benchmarks, however, usually treat planning data as fixed collections of instances rather than controllable generation targets. This limits scenario coverage, ties difficulty to surface-level proxies rather than structural sources, and offers limited suppo

summary.core_problem: PlanningBench 解决的是规划数据难以规模化生成、难以控制结构难度、难以自动验证的问题。它把规划 benchmark 从固定题集改成可控的数据生成框架，并同时服务评测和训练。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 和 reasoning 数据构造有参考价值。关键启发是：规划能力的训练信号应尽量来自可执行、可验证的约束系统，而不是只依赖自然语言答案或人工偏好。它也提供了一个较清晰的思路：用领域专家抽象任务结构，再用程序化约束生成实例和验证器，形成可扩展的 RL 训练数据。对预训练研究员来说，更有价值的部分是数据生成与验证信号设计，而不是具体规划任务本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是约束驱动的数据合成。PlanningBench 先从真实规划场景出发，由领域专家抽象出任务类型、子任务、约束族和难度因子。论文称其覆盖 30 多类规划任务，每类任务包含多个子任务和任务特定约束。生成时，系统先采样结构化的任务-约束配置，再实例化为自包含的规划问题。之后加入受控难度增强和质量过滤。难度不只由题目长度或要求数量决定，而是通过约束紧度、资源稀缺程度、目标冲突、子任务依赖、全局协调要求等因素控制。每个样本都配有自动验证规则，用于检查约束满足情况和目标质量。这一点和静态 benchmark 的差别较大：它不是收集一批题，而是定义一个能持续产出题目、答案检查器和训练奖励的生成系统。训练侧使用通过验证的数据做 GRPO，利用自动验证结果构造规划任务的强化学习反馈。
summary.experiments: 论文从评测和训练两条线验证 PlanningBench。评测侧覆盖开源和闭源前沿 LLM，结论是强模型在该 benchmark 上仍有明显未解空间。论文还分析了不同任务主题、prompt 长度、checklist item 数量对成功率的影响，用于定位模型在复杂约束和长程协调上的失败模式。训练侧用 PlanningBench 的可验证数据做 GRPO，并测试分布外迁移。结果显示，训练后的模型在 TravelPlanner 和 ChinaTravel 等未见规划 benchmark 上有提升，同时在 Multi-Challenge、Inverse IFEval、Collie 等更宽的指令遵循和复杂推理评测上也有收益。提供的正文片段没有包含具体模型规模、训练数据量、绝对分数和提升幅度，因此不宜补充未确认数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看三部分：第一，数据构造章节，尤其是任务 taxonomy、约束族、难度因子的定义；第二，自动验证规则如何表达约束满足和目标质量，这决定了它能否成为稳定的 RL 信号；第三，GRPO 训练和分布外评测结果，观察规划数据是否只提升同类任务，还是能迁移到更一般的 instruction-following 和 reasoning。若时间有限，可跳过大部分具体任务案例，保留对生成管线和验证机制的理解。

summary_en.core_problem: PlanningBench addresses a data problem in LLM planning: existing benchmarks are mostly fixed collections of instances, with limited controllability over structural difficulty, coverage, scalability, and automatic verification. The paper reframes planning evaluation as controllable generation of verifiable planning instances.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to post-training and reasoning data design. Its main value is the construction of executable and automatically verifiable planning signals. For researchers working on foundation-model training, the useful part is not the specific travel or workflow-style tasks, but the recipe for turning structured constraints into scalable evaluation data and RL rewards. This is a cleaner signal than free-form natural-language supervision or preference-only feedback when the target capability is constraint satisfaction and long-horizon coordination.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework starts from real planning scenarios and abstracts them into a taxonomy of task types, subtasks, constraint families, and difficulty factors. The paper states that the taxonomy covers more than 30 planning tasks, each with multiple subtasks and task-specific constraints. The generation pipeline samples structured task-constraint configurations, instantiates them as self-contained planning problems, applies controlled difficulty enhancement, and filters outputs after generation. Difficulty is controlled through structural factors such as constraint tightness, resource scarcity, objective conflicts, subtask dependencies, and global coordination requirements, rather than only through superficial proxies such as prompt length. Each instance is paired with automatic verification rules that check constraint satisfaction and objective quality. For training, the authors use verified PlanningBench data with GRPO, using the verifier as a source of planning-oriented feedback.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates both open-source and closed-source frontier LLMs and reports that even the strongest tested models have limited solve rates on PlanningBench, suggesting that the benchmark is not saturated. The analysis covers task topics, prompt length, and the number of checklist items, which helps diagnose how scenario structure and constraint complexity affect planning success. On the training side, GRPO with verified PlanningBench data improves transfer to unseen planning benchmarks such as TravelPlanner and ChinaTravel. The trained models also show gains on broader instruction-following and complex reasoning benchmarks, including Multi-Challenge, Inverse IFEval, and Collie. The provided full-content excerpt does not include concrete model sizes, data scale, absolute scores, or improvement numbers, so those details should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the data construction pipeline, especially the task taxonomy, constraint families, and difficulty factors. Then read the verifier design, since the verifier is what turns the benchmark into a potential RL training source. Finally, inspect the GRPO and out-of-distribution evaluation sections to see whether the generated planning data transfers beyond its own templates. Most individual task examples can be read selectively unless one is building a similar generator.

paper.title: STAR-PólyaMath: Multi-Agent Reasoning under Persistent Meta-Strategic Supervision
paper.abstract: Frontier AI models and multi-agent systems have led to significant improvements in mathematical reasoning. However, for problems requiring extended, long-horizon reasoning, existing systems continue to suffer from fundamental reliability issues: hallucination accumulation, memory fragmentation, and imbalanced reasoning-tool trade-offs. In this paper, we introduce STAR-PólyaMath, a multi-agent framework that systematically addresses these challenges through meta-level supervision and structured R

summary.core_problem: 现有多智能体数学推理系统在长程推理问题上存在三个根本缺陷：幻觉累积（中间推理错误沿长轨迹传播）、记忆碎片化（回溯时难以保留关键信息、或保留过多冗余上下文）、推理-工具权衡失衡（过度依赖代码搜索掩盖数学结构，缺乏元认知能力调整策略）。论文提出通过持续元策略监督来系统性解决这些问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启示主要在post-train和推理范式层面：(1) 长程推理的可靠性瓶颈可能不在模型知识本身，而在推理过程的结构化管理——这对RL训练中reward信号的设计（如何奖励结构化推理而非蛮力搜索）有参考价值；(2) 元策略监督作为一种训练-free的推理编排方案，其有效性暗示某些推理缺陷可通过更好的推理调度弥补，而非必须通过额外预训练或SFT；(3) 分离控制流与推理（用无推理能力的Python orchestrator做状态机控制）的架构设计对降低错误传播有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: STAR-PólyaMath框架包含三个LLM角色：Reasoner（生成推理步骤）、Verifier（验证每一步正确性）、以及一个持续存在的Meta-Strategist（元策略师，在整个解题过程中保持全局监督，跨尝试维护策略记忆，发布元策略决策）。整个系统由无推理能力的Python orchestrator编排，通过显式状态机推进（包含嵌套的challenge-step-replan循环），将控制流与推理分离，通过回溯和重新规划限制错误传播。Reasoner和Verifier通过结构化双向辩论循环互动。
summary.experiments: 在多个竞赛数学基准上取得当前最佳成绩：AIME 2025、MathArena Apex Shortlist、MathArena Apex 2025、Putnam 2025、IMO 2025、AIME 2026、HMMT 2026年2月、USAMO 2026。最大优势在MathArena Apex 2025（93.75 vs. 最强基线GPT-5.5的80.21）。消融实验表明框架各组件均有独立贡献；将共享骨干替换为混合模型配置并未提升结果，说明收益来自编排框架而非模型选择本身。实验详细数据集和更多消融数字未在已读部分完全展示。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点阅读§3方法部分的架构图（Figure 1）和状态机设计（challenge-step-replan嵌套循环）、Meta-Strategist的具体干预方式。实验结果部分关注跨基准的对比表和消融实验表。对预训练研究员，核心关注元策略监督如何通过结构化编排减少错误传播——这一原则可迁移到训练数据构造中。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent mathematical reasoning systems suffer from three fundamental failure modes on long-horizon problems: hallucination accumulation (errors propagate along long solution trajectories), memory fragmentation (difficulty retaining salient information across backtracking attempts while avoiding excessive context), and imbalanced reasoning-tool trade-offs (over-reliance on brute-force code search obscures mathematical structure, lacking metacognition to revise strategy). This work introduces persistent meta-level supervision as a systematic remedy.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the implications are primarily at the post-train and inference paradigm level: (1) Long-horizon reasoning reliability bottlenecks may lie in structured management of the inference process rather than model knowledge itself—this informs reward signal design in RL training (how to reward structured reasoning over brute-force search); (2) The effectiveness of training-free meta-strategic supervision suggests certain reasoning deficits can be mitigated through better inference orchestration without additional pretraining or SFT; (3) The separation of control flow from inference (a reasoning-free Python orchestrator managing a state machine) has practical implications for reducing error propagation.
summary_en.technical_approach: STAR-PólyaMath features three LLM roles: Reasoner (generates reasoning steps), Verifier (validates each step), and a persistent Meta-Strategist (maintains global oversight throughout the entire problem-solving process, retains strategic memory across attempts, issues meta-strategic decisions). A reasoning-free Python orchestrator coordinates the system via an explicit state machine with nested challenge-step-replan loops, separating control from inference and bounding error propagation through trace-back and re-planning. The Reasoner and Verifier interact through structured bidirectional debate loops.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves best-reported scores across AIME 2025, MathArena Apex Shortlist, MathArena Apex 2025, Putnam 2025, IMO 2025, AIME 2026, HMMT February 2026, and USAMO 2026. Largest margin on MathArena Apex 2025 (93.75 vs. 80.21 by the strongest baseline GPT-5.5). Ablation studies show each framework component contributes independently; swapping the shared backbone for mixed-model configurations does not improve results, indicating gains come from orchestration rather than model selection. Full experimental details and additional ablation numbers not fully available in the read sections.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skim-level reading: focus on §3 (Method) architecture diagram (Figure 1) and the state machine design (nested challenge-step-replan loops), plus the Meta-Strategist's specific intervention mechanisms. In results, examine the cross-benchmark comparison tables and ablation tables. For pretraining researchers, the key takeaway is how structured orchestration via meta-strategic supervision reduces error propagation—a principle transferable to training data construction. Estimated reading time: 20–25 minutes.

recommendation.en: This is reasoning orchestration more than pretraining; borrow the trace-back/replan design, but do not read it like a pretraining paper.

paper.title: Greedy or not, here I come: Language production under vocabulary constraints in humans and resource-rational models
paper.abstract: Communicating using only a limited vocabulary is a common but challenging cognitive phenomenon, requiring an ideal communicator to plan carefully to optimize for intelligibility while circumventing a constrained lexicon. In this work, we investigate how humans respond to a broad array of questions under variable vocabulary limitations, consisting of only 250 highly frequent words at the most restrictive. We provide theoretically motivated comparisons to greedy and globally optimal sampling algor

summary.core_problem: 研究人在受限词表下如何生成语言，并比较人类行为更接近贪心采样还是全局规划式生成。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是认知建模和语言生成机制分析。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对理解受限解码、规划成本和人类语言生成的近似策略有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 设计可变词表限制的问答任务，最严格条件下只允许使用 250 个高频词。用大语言模型构造 resource-rational models，并比较 greedy sampling 与基于 Sequential Monte Carlo 的全局最优采样。分析人类在高约束下是否会回溯、修改，以及是否偏向使用语义较轻的词。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参与者数量、所用 LLM、问题数量或量化提升。主要结果是人类整体更像贪心采样而非全局最优采样；能力更强的人更可能回溯和修改；高约束下依赖语义较轻词的模式同时可由贪心和全局最优模型产生。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 MIT 和 Harvard University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how humans produce language under vocabulary constraints and whether their behavior is better explained by greedy generation or globally planned sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is a cognitive-modeling and language-production analysis. It is not a pretraining method paper, but it is relevant to constrained decoding, planning cost, and approximations in language generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors run a question-answering setup with variable vocabulary limits, down to 250 highly frequent words in the most restrictive condition. They compare human responses with greedy sampling and globally optimal sampling implemented through Sequential Monte Carlo inference using large language models, while analyzing backtracking and revision behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not state participant count, model choice, number of prompts, or numerical effect sizes. It reports that humans generally resemble greedy sampling more than globally optimal sampling; more skilled humans backtrack and revise more often; and the use of semantically light words under high constraint arises in both greedy and globally optimal models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from MIT and Harvard University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 decoding 与人类规划成本的弱信号可扫一眼；只看实验设计和人类更像 greedy 的结果即可。
recommendation.en: A weak but interesting signal on decoding and human planning cost; skim the setup and the result that humans look closer to greedy sampling.

However, these approaches rely on simple numeric scores to signal program quality, such as the value of the solution or the number of passed tests. Because a score offers no guidance on why a program failed, the system must generate and evaluate many candidates hoping some succeed, increasing LLM inference and evaluation costs. We study a different approach: property-guided LLM program syn

summary.importance: 提出属性引导的程序合成范式，属于程序合成领域的方法创新，可降低LLM推理与程序验证成本
summary.technical_approach: 在程序评估前检查候选是否满足形式化定义的属性，违反时提前终止评估并向LLM提供具体反例说明失败原因，而非仅给出数值评分

paper.title: Look Before You Leap: Autonomous Exploration for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model based agents often fail in unfamiliar environments due to premature exploitation: a tendency to act on prior knowledge before acquiring sufficient environment-specific information. We identify autonomous exploration as a critical yet underexplored capability for building adaptive agents. To formalize and quantify this capability, we introduce Exploration Checkpoint Coverage, a verifiable metric that measures how broadly an agent discovers key states, objects, and affordances

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 在陌生交互环境里常出现“过早利用”（premature exploitation）：还没弄清环境状态/物体/可用动作（affordance）就按训练期先验直接执行任务，导致反复撞墙或语义错配。论文要解决的是：把“自主探索”从任务完成里剥离成可度量、可优化的独立能力，并证明常见的任务导向 RL/RLVR 并不会自然学出这种能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法论文，但对“RL 作为 post-train 信号如何反哺通用能力”有明确启示：只用任务回报会把策略压到窄轨迹，削弱在分布外环境中的信息获取与适应。它把探索能力做成可验证指标（ECC）并给出可操作的训练配方（interleaved GRPO），适合作为后训练阶段的能力补齐模块；对做 tool/UI/文本世界交互的通用 agent 训练，属于可复用的训练信号设计。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 指标：提出 Exploration Checkpoint Coverage (ECC)。核心思想是把环境里“关键状态/对象/可用交互”抽象成一组可验证的 checkpoints，agent 在探索阶段触达/发现的 checkpoints 越多，ECC 越高。它强调 verifiable：奖励不依赖主观打分，而是由环境可判定的触发条件给出。
2) 诊断：用 ECC 系统评估多种开源模型与训练范式，结论是任务导向训练（包括强 RLVR 式的 task-completion 优化）会导致探索早停、覆盖面窄、重复访问熟悉状态。
3) 训练：提出 interleaved GRPO（文中描述为将两类 rollout 交错进行）。一类 rollout 做任务执行，用任务完成的可验证奖励；另一类 rollout 专门做探索，用 ECC 作为奖励，直接把“覆盖更多关键点”变成优化目标。两类 rollout 共享同一策略模型，但优化目标分开，避免探索被任务回报挤压。
4) 推理范式：Explore-then-Act。部署时先花一段交互预算做自主探索以收集环境知识，再进入任务执行阶段；强调把“先建模环境再做事”制度化，而不是让模型在任务过程中被动试错。
summary.experiments:
全文实验覆盖 ALFWorld、SciWorld、TextCraft 以及一个更难的 ALFWorld 变体。主要结论是：
- 现有任务导向训练在 ECC 上表现出系统性低覆盖与重复行为；
- 用 ECC 奖励做探索训练后，ECC 显著提高，并能把同样的初始交互预算转化为更有效的环境知识；
- 下游任务成功率/鲁棒性随之提升，尤其在更难的 ALFWorld 变体上更明显。
给定你提供的全文片段未包含表格数字与具体模型配置（参数量、训练步数、提升幅度），这里无法可靠复述精确数值；精确数字需要对照论文的结果表与消融表。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 ECC 的定义与“checkpoint”如何构造/验证：这是整篇工作的可迁移部分，决定奖励是否会被投机。
- 再看“任务导向训练不产生探索”的诊断实验：重点关注他们如何控制交互预算、如何统计重复轨迹与早停。
- 最后看 interleaved GRPO 的训练细节：两类 rollout 的比例、奖励归一化/截断、以及是否会牺牲任务性能来换探索。
如果你在做 RLVR/RLAIF 训练管线，值得额外检查：ECC 是否会引入 reward hacking（例如刷 checkpoint），以及作者是否用约束/去重/冷却机制抑制这种行为（通常会在实现细节或消融里）。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents deployed in unfamiliar interactive environments often “exploit too early”: they commit to actions driven by training-time priors before acquiring environment-specific information (states, objects, affordances). The paper isolates autonomous exploration as a standalone capability, makes it measurable, and shows that task-centric RL/RLVR does not reliably produce it.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is directly relevant to the pretrain↔post-train loop: optimizing only for task completion can collapse behavior into narrow trajectories, hurting adaptation under distribution shift. The work contributes (i) a verifiable exploration metric (ECC) and (ii) a concrete RL recipe (interleaved GRPO) that can be plugged into agent post-training to build a reusable “explore first” capability for tool/UI/text-world interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Metric: Exploration Checkpoint Coverage (ECC). The environment is instrumented with a set of verifiable checkpoints representing key states/objects/affordances; the exploration reward is proportional to how broadly the agent discovers them.
2) Diagnosis: Using ECC, the authors evaluate multiple models/training paradigms and find task-oriented optimization leads to premature termination, low coverage, and repetitive interactions.
3) Training: Interleaved GRPO alternates two rollout types: task-execution rollouts optimized with task-completion verifiable rewards, and exploration rollouts optimized with ECC reward. Separating objectives prevents task reward from dominating and suppressing exploration.
4) Deployment: Explore-then-Act allocates an explicit interaction budget to exploration before attempting the task, turning “environment understanding” into a first-class stage rather than incidental trial-and-error.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span ALFWorld, SciWorld, TextCraft, plus a harder ALFWorld variant. Reported outcomes: task-centric baselines exhibit systematically low ECC and repetitive behaviors; ECC-trained agents achieve higher coverage and convert the same initial interaction budget into more useful environment knowledge, improving downstream task success and robustness (especially on the harder variant). The provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables (model sizes, data/steps, absolute gains), so exact figures cannot be stated without the results section tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the formal definition of ECC and how checkpoints are constructed/verified; this determines whether the reward is robust to gaming.
- Check the diagnostic setup that claims “task training doesn’t yield exploration”: pay attention to fixed interaction budgets and how repetition/early-stop are quantified.
- Review interleaved GRPO details: rollout mixing ratio, reward scaling, and any trade-off between exploration and task performance.
If you run RLVR pipelines, explicitly look for anti-hacking measures (deduping checkpoints, constraints, cooldowns), typically in implementation details and ablations.

recommendation.zh: 读 metric 和 rollout 设计即可；它把 agent RL 的失败归因从“不会规划”推进到“训练时没奖励探索”。
recommendation.en: Read the metric and rollout design; it reframes some agent-RL failures from poor planning to unrewarded exploration.
